notes.title: Big Next Fest Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo Overhaul[/h1][p][/p][h2]Snail mission overhaul (& Grappling hook?)[/h2][p]Snails will no longer be a complete menace pulling you around, he's now a lot more controlable. Along with this, the grappling hook has been upgraded and can now be used on basically anything. So go wild flinging humans around![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177375/0268ebc3a1b4c2e5f34d01aadba12d7e59ebcea9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]4 New Visiting NPCs[/h2][p]Cult Leader Capy, Freaky Frogger, Crazy Coq & Sam the Sheep who will be in the full game have come to visit the demo. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177375/02edf12262ca13c26d077ef2d0e819d1ae456006.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Terrain Update[/h2][p]The terrain now looks a lot cleaner, so you can get even more immersed into the island.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177375/a9806a4fdeee3d0ec5dc275fae3d3db670cc7642.png"][/img][/p][h2]Bug Fixes![/h2][p]A lot more boring, but I went around and fixed all the issues I could find. notes.title: Big Demo Update
notes.content:
[h2]Car Quality is ːsteamthisː[/h2]
The car has received a bunch of quality of life improvements including, but not limited to:
[list]
[*] Holding down boost without pressing any other movement keys now works.
[*] Driving into ramps fast now doesn't cause you to crash anymore, so you can start flying easier now.
[*] Added a tooltip that shows up, to tell you what button to press to correct your car's rotation (handy after a bad landing)
[*] I'm getting tired of listing these, so go explore for yourself and tell me if your biggest pet peeve is fixed or not! 
[/list]

[h2]Controller remapping! (& settings visual update)[/h2]
Key rebinding [i]only supports keyboard[/i] for now, but you can now rebind your keys however you want. (pro tip, the in air tilting forwards and backwards is part of the steering input)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177375/0af09d9cd7d8f16e3348a749720290b9a6ea300f.png[/img]
The settings menu looks [b]way [/b]better now, with more permament art ːsteamhappyː.

[h2]New Menu[/h2]
There's a new menu, go ahead and check it out.

[h2]Optimisations[/h2]
Although I haven't yet perfected optimisation, the game [b]should[/b] run [i]smoother [/i]now.

[h2]I did other things, no clue what they are though, I forgot to write most things down ːsteamboredː.[/h2]

[h2]Next Update[/h2]
For the next update I'll tackle sound, although I have no idea when this update will be as I want to mostly work on the full game unless any big bugs get reported. ːsteamsadː

notes.title: Another round of bug fixes
notes.content:
[h1]These are the bugs that are fixes:[/h1]
[h3]The first one was a big fix[/h3]
-	[list]
[*] For new players the first mission doesn’t even start, how did I go so long without realizing that lol.
[*] -	You can now skip the text loading by pressing interact again.
[*] -	Fixed Vacuum sucker not working, you can’t shoot.
[*] -	Bombs don’t have explosion sound.
[*] -	Controller movement now uses the triggers to give gas and slow down.
[*] -	Controlls have been remapped for controller. (input map can be found in the main menu)
[*] -	Can't turn anymore when not moving.
[*] -	Fixed bug where snail bugs out when you start final mission.
[*] -	Bring Snail to mechanic mission sets the snail’s position to the beach in start if the mission is 
[*]         active.
[*] -	Going to golden goose (after doing snails missions) is now a mission.
[*] -	Made new minimap icon for geese and snail.
[*] -	Reduced chromatic aberration.
[*] -	Fixed different screen resolutions like 1920 x 1200 caused HUD to be cut off.
[*] -	You could control the pause menu when in options.
[*] -	Fixed bug where boost meter will appear, disappear and re-appear.
[*] - Fixed the "Did you know you can press..." blocking options menu back button.
[*] - Fixed more bugs happening on different ratios than 16:9
[*] - Fixed apprentice AI to be less buggy
[*] - Base acceleration is faster now.
[*] - Fixed spelling mistake.
[*] - Fixed bug where ../10 would reset to whatever amount of bombs were left if you fell into the water.
[*] - Removed cutout effect for containters.
[*] - Removed artifacts in some dialogue where a square would appear.
[*] - Replaced minecraft TNT explosion to stop Mojang Assassins.
[*] - Added SFX when hitting Perry the pig in the air.
[*] - Made snail a bit less annoying.
[*] - Added sound effect when connecting to things using box attachment
[*] - Made NPC respawn also happen when outside of world bounds.
[*] - You can now close weapon selection using enter as well.
[*] - Fixed seam on vacuum machine effect.
[*] - Made fart-nados go faster & not teleport way up high when passing a high wall.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
I spent the day fixing reported bugs and trying to break the game myself to find bugs to fix. If you come across any remaining bugs, do report them!

Here are the bugs I fixed:
-	You can't get stuck under bridge next to mechanic anymore.
-	Fixed invisible collider at mechanic's shop that caused car to tilt and become uncontrollable.
-      Fixed bugs to do with the reset data tab & save system.
-	Fixed: Most of the time when you hit a civillan their body ragdoll with go under the floor and cease to exist
-	Fixed: Final goose mission not working when you die.
-	Mostly Fixed: When going really fast NPC ragdoll still seem to go under ground.
-	Addition: Make it so you can’t save when an NPC is talking
-	Addition: Text pop up showing saving progress & buttons get disabled while saving.
-	Fixed: Bug where speedbomb gets turned on when dying from geese.
-	Fixed: Text balloon saying "dddd" due to saving bug.
-       And more smaller bugs.

Don't forget to leave a review on the demo if you liked it. Have a nice rest of your day! :)
